payload.text: CommandPalette is a labelled modal dialog implementing the ARIA APG combobox/listbox pattern: the surface is role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="command palette"; results render as role="listbox" with role="option" rows carrying aria-selected on the active item. Keyboard handling (ArrowUp/ArrowDown to move the active option, Enter to run, Escape to close) plus open-time focus of the search input make it fully keyboard-operable. This is the ⌘K command surface, so its dialog+listbox a11y contract is the reference for overlay launchers.
